rtx4090.verdict: BEST LOCAL GPU for AI startup. Runs Wan2.1 1.3B (4min/video), 14B (8min), Ollama 14B, SDXL, Flux, ComfyUI. Sweet spot for price/performance.
rtx4090.limitations: Cannot run multiple 14B models simultaneously. Training large models needs cloud H100.

rtx5090.verdict: FUTURE-PROOF upgrade from 4090. 33% more VRAM, 27% faster. Worth the $400 premium if buying new.

a6000.verdict: ENTERPRISE choice. 48GB VRAM for multi-model serving. Lower power. But 2.9x the price of 4090 for similar performance.

h100.verdict: DATA CENTER GPU — DO NOT BUY. Rent via RunPod ($2.49/hr) when needed for training. 6x faster than 4090 but $1,600 vs $30,000.
